messages:
Ellie (support): heads-up — three customers just sent in PDFs showing 500s from the hosted API (/v1/generate). They expected 429s for quota but got 500s. First reports ~15:37 UTC. sample response body: `{"error":"internal server error"}`. Customers affected: acme-inc, nimble-ai, shoply.

Samir Patel: looking at gateway traces now. I see the gateway calling quota-orch which times out and returns a 5xx. Gateway classification treats downstream 5xx as 5xx to client. Trace id sample: `trc-1a2b3c`. logs: 
```
2026-03-14T15:37:12Z quota-orch [WARN] request_id=trc-1a2b3c upstream_timeout 12002ms
2026-03-14T15:37:12Z quota-orch [ERROR] request_id=trc-1a2b3c failed to fetch token info: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-14T15:37:12Z gateway [INFO] request_id=trc-1a2b3c quota-orch returned 500 -> responding 500
```

Tom I (infra): confirming. I see a small spike in dependency latency for token-store in us-west-2 around 15:36-15:38 UTC. Multiple reads hit p99 auth latency ~1.1s causing quota-orch to hit its 1s deadline and surface 500.

Jen Park (eng-runtime): this is root-cause class mismatch. If quota-orch times out due to upstream auth latency we should treat that as a quota enforcement failure (4xx) or a graceful degrade, not a hard 5xx. There was a recent change (2026-03-14 03:24 UTC) that flipped `quota_error_behavior=fail_hard` during a rollout — that might be why. @Tom can you confirm that flag?

Tom I (infra): @Jen yes that flag was toggled during the late-night config push to make quota-orch stricter for \"cold starts\". rollout id `cfg-20260314-3`. I can revert it.

Maya Li (oncall): customer impact seems limited but visible. We should mitigate fast: 1) convert quota-orch 5xx -> 429 at gateway for known timeout codes, 2) revert `quota_error_behavior` toggle if safe, 3) throttle back aggressive timeouts. I'm going to open a quick mitigation ticket. @deploy-bot can you run a quick gateway config push to add a mapping rule?

deploy-bot: starting config change `gw-map-5xx-to-429-quota-timeout` -> deploy started (canary on prod-gw-1).

Samir Patel: repro steps for engineers:
1) curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <test_token>\" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
2) observe 500 with header `x-rw-trace: trc-1a2b3c`
3) check gateway logs for `quota-orch returned 500` entry.

Ellie (support): drafted customer message: \"we're investigating intermittent 500s on generation endpoints. We believe quota validation calls are hitting a transient dependency timeout and we're rolling a fix — recommended retry in 30s. We'll update again in 1 hour.\" Posting now to affected customers. :shipit:

Jen Park (eng-runtime): I'm going to open a patch to the gateway error classifier to map quota-orch upstream timeout errors (error code `DEP_TIMEOUT` and `token-store-DELAY`) to 429. That's safer than returning 500s for rate/limit semantics. Samir, can you add a unit test and small integration smoke?

Samir Patel: on it. I'll also add a feature-flagged check so we can toggle behaviour without rollback. Plan: land mapping + tests in next 10m, then monitor error-rate.

Tom I (infra): I've queued a rollback of `cfg-20260314-3` to restore previous lenient behavior; rollback in 2m. I'll post rollback id.

quota-bot: ALERT @channel quota-orch error-rate > 4% (15:37-15:40 UTC) — escalation threshold breached.

Maya Li (oncall): after deploy canaries look good, we'll promote to all gateways. Keep an eye on p99 latency for token-store. Postmortem action items (quick):
- Samir: make classifier map timeouts -> 429 permanently (owner).
- Tom: add auto-revert guard for config flips that increase hard-fail responses (owner).
- Jen: add integration test that simulates token-store slow and assert gateway returns 429 not 500 (owner).
- Ellie: follow up with customers with timeline and RCA when we have it (owner).

Ellie (support): customers acknowledged, appreciate the rapid response. I'll keep this thread updated with any replies. :heart:

Samir Patel: pushed mapping to canary, logs show gateway mapping matched `DEP_TIMEOUT` -> responded 429; error-rate for 5xx dropped ~88% in canary. Rolling to prod now.

Maya Li (oncall): promoted mapping to all gateways at 15:45 UTC. Monitoring; so far so good. Closing immediate customer impact ticket. We'll keep incident open for follow-up RCA.

Jen Park (eng-runtime): follow-up next steps recorded in incident tracker: add metric for `quota-orch:dep_timeout_count`, add alert for config flips that change client-visible status codes, and schedule RCA write-up.

Tom I (infra): rollback id `cfg-20260314-3-rollback-1` completed at 15:48 UTC. Verified previous behavior restored.

quota-bot: RESOLVED: error-rate returned to normal.

Maya Li (oncall): summary: transient token-store latency caused quota-orch timeouts; config change exposed a fail-hard behavior that caused 5xx responses instead of 4xx; mitigated by gateway mapping + rollback. Owners as above, RCA and follow-up actions will be tracked in the incident doc.
